title: Further slice restriction of the localization coefficient
statement: Let (C,J) be a small site, R a sheaf of commutative rings, a:V→U an arrow and f a section on U. Write S_f=R_U[1/f] for the sheafified localization coefficient [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-localization-complex-models]. Further slice restriction of S_f is canonically isomorphic to R_V[1/R(a)f]. Construct the comparison as the identity between the appropriate fraction presheaves, transported through equality of the restricted denominators by functoriality of R and through the canonical restriction/sheafification isomorphism [lem-weil-pbc-slice-module-sheafification].

source.place: Tags 03CY, 03DH and 04IX; tensor/sheafification and continuous restriction.

proof.text: For a continuous functor, restriction of the localization presheaf is the localization presheaf of the restricted section. Its component is the identity, and its naturality is equality of the same localization restriction maps.

On iterated slices the restricted denominator agrees with the direct restricted denominator by functoriality of the ring sheaf. Sheafify the resulting presheaf isomorphism and compose with continuous cocontinuous restriction commuting with module sheafification.

proof_origin.place: The indicated construction in the parent proof; direct formal implementation of its representative, evaluation, tensor, or sheafification comparisons.
